coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Rock Terry A Francois Boulevard Paseo (Pier 48 entry)
names: Mission Rock Terry A Francois Boulevard Paseo (Pier 48 entry)

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE but high confidence on three edges (recorded lot lines); the south edge is the Exposition Street lot line extended ~23 m east, which is where the plan's Exposition Street right-of-way ends at TAFB. Planned (Design Controls Section 4.3.4: the boulevard 'will become a paseo'); no source read describes its current use. ANGLE CHECK: check_geometry_quality.py flags a 12.3-12.6 deg corner here (its tolerance is 12 deg). Three of this polygon's four vertices are real, recorded DataSF Assessor lot corners; the south-east vertex is not, since it closes the south edge on the extended Exposition Street line (see digitization_method). The flagged deviation is at two of the recorded corners, so it is the real lots' own shape (Bridgeview Way's paseo lot 8719A007 and the Exposition Street lot 8719A010 meet the park lot 8719A005 at a corner that is not exactly square), not a shear or a misread trace. Accepted; see docs/site-definition-of-done.md.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor lot lines: the north end of the Terry A Francois Boulevard lot 8719A003 between Block K, the Pier 48 lot 8719A001 and the China Basin Park lot 8719A005; named as a paseo in Mission Rock Design Controls Figure 3.1.1 (p.45), Section 4.3 (p.90) and Figure 3.6.1 (p.71).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Part of the Terry A Francois Boulevard right-of-way lot 8719A003 (DataSF Assessor parcels, recorded 2020-06-12; it also carries the roadway south of here and Channel Wharf); joining status.csv to it would paint the whole boulevard (our mapping rationale, not a statement of the Design Controls).
notes.regulatory_context: Design Controls Section 4.3 / 3.6: the TAFB terminus is a paseo facilitating park and water-oriented access to Pier 48, with a kiosk and picnic area connecting the pier apron to China Basin Park (Figure 3.6.1).

milestones.text: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which name this planned paseo at the Terry A Francois Boulevard / Pier 48 entry (Design Controls Section 4.3); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sept 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05)

changes.text: The map notes said the paseo is an interim roadway today, that satellite imagery shows the paved road to the Pier 48 gate, and that every vertex is a recorded lot corner. No imagery source was cited for the first two, so they are removed or marked unverified; the notes now quote the Design Controls (the boulevard 'will become a paseo'). The vertex claim is corrected: three of four vertices are recorded DataSF lot corners and the south-east one is on an extended line. The claim that the first two paseos were built with Phase 1 now cites the Port's Feb 2025 minutes and June 2026 report, and the lot facts cite DataSF. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone and its change entry now cite the Sept 2019 Port memo that states the date.
